subject: Signature staging & onboarding start-week planning (final MAP milestones)
messages:
From: Sarah Mendes <sarah.mendes@oliveretail.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Huang <tom.huang@oliveretail.com>
Date: Sat, 27 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: MAP + final timing questions before legal review

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the MAP draft — team reviewed and we have a couple of timing asks before we put this into legal:

- Can Redwood confirm who will be signing the SOW vs who signs the DSPA? We have a hard internal deadline of 2026-07-08 for contracting to avoid delaying our Q3 rollout.
- We need a short approval window for SOC2 evidence (security team prefers 48 hours for a final artifact review). Will you be able to provide the SOC2 summary and the elliott-runbook artifact by EOD Monday?

Attached our internal checklist for redlines (signature_queue.csv).

Would appreciate a short call if any of this is blocking.

Best,
Sarah
Head of Procurement, Olive Retail
procurement@oliveretail.com

Attachments: signature_queue.csv (CSV list of signers, internal PO #, requested start date)

From: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Mendes <sarah.mendes@oliveretail.com>
Cc: Tom Huang <tom.huang@oliveretail.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + final timing questions before legal review

Sarah — thanks for the checklist and the clear deadlines. Short summary and proposed MAP adjustments below (I attached a revised MAP_v3.xlsx with milestone dates):

1) Signers and sequence
   - Redwood will have two signers: Chief Revenue Officer (Aditya Rao) for the commercial SOW and VP Legal (Jordan Blake) for data/contract side. Both delegated via DocuSign.
   - Proposed signing window: July 6–9; primary signing target July 8 to meet your internal deadline.

2) SOC2 / security artifacts
   - We can deliver the SOC2 summary and the runtime evidence snapshot by EOD Monday (2026-06-29). Security will allow a 48-hour review window (June 30–July 1).

3) Evaluation environment and start-week
   - We will provision the evaluation cluster (MAP milestone: "eval environment ready") by July 2. Onboarding start-week (customer-facing) proposed July 12.

4) Redlines and legal path
   - Please upload your SOW redlines to the Drive link; Jordan will triage and we aim for one negotiated pass. If redlines are purely commercial, Aditya can accept via delegated authority to avoid legal bottlenecks.

Next steps I recommend: short 20-min alignment call with Tom and your security lead tomorrow (June 30) to walk through SOC2 artifacts and the DocuSign sequence. I copied Aditya to confirm sign-off authority.

Thanks — I attached MAP_v3.xlsx and the draft SOW with our comments (SOW_redlines_olive_v2.pdf).

—Grace
Senior Sales Director, Redwood Inference
Attachments: MAP_v3.xlsx (MAP milestones spreadsheet); SOW_redlines_olive_v2.pdf (annotated redlines)

From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + final timing questions before legal review

Grace / Jordan — I confirm I will be primary signer for the commercial SOW and have delegated DocuSign rights for July 6–9. I approve the proposed July 8 target as the signing date.

Jordan — please prioritize the contract review for July 1–2 so we can finalize the DocuSign envelope. If you want me to step into any commercial trade-offs, flag them.

Aditya
Chief Revenue Officer, Redwood Inference

(On a separate note: will coordinate with finance to unblock the PO so Olive can sign and not delay start-week.)

From: jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP + final timing questions before legal review

Grace / Aditya — I reviewed Olive's redlines in SOW_redlines_olive_v2.pdf. Most edits are standard; I will clear the legal pass by July 2 COB. SOC2 summary looks fine — security team will push the runtime evidence snapshot to the shared Drive this afternoon.

Please queue the DocuSign envelope and tag me as a signer on the contract flow for VP-Legal review. Once the e-sign envelope is ready, Aditya can sign for commercial and I will countersign within the DocuSign workflow.

—Jordan
VP Legal, Redwood Inference

From: Tom Huang <tom.huang@oliveretail.com>
To: grace_oconnor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Sarah Mendes <sarah.mendes@oliveretail.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>, jordan_blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: RE: MAP + final timing questions before legal review

Grace — this looks good and aligns with our internal timeline. Quick confirmations from Olive side:

- Procurement will release the PO immediately upon DocuSign routing (we'll provide the PO number in-thread).
- Security will complete the 48-hour review on July 1 and provide any final comments by EOD.
- Targeted start-week July 12 is acceptable; we'll schedule onboarding sessions for July 12–15.

I'll expect the DocuSign envelope link and a short note about the start-week onboarding agenda. Thanks for the quick turnaround.

Tom
Sr. Program Manager, Olive Retail

Forwarded attachment: signature_queue.csv (internal signer order)
